meta.title: About Essentia | Our Philosophy & Team
meta.description: Learn about Essentia's philosophy, our expert team, and our commitment to holistic wellness and longevity in Tenerife.

hero.imageAlt: Essentia — interior of the club in Costa Adeje
hero.body: Essentia grew out of a vision Yuli and Alex share: a place where body care, prevention and advanced wellness are lived personally, closely and consciously.

story.heading: Why we exist.
story.p1: Essentia grew out of two paths meeting: Yuli's therapeutic experience and Alex's creative, strategic and experiential vision.
story.p2: Yuli is the therapeutic heart of Essentia. Her career in massage, wellness and manual therapy comes from years of training, practice and direct contact with the body. Working as a therapist has given her a precise, sensitive and deeply human eye, and the understanding that every person needs different care and support suited to the moment they are in.
story.p3: Her work brings together knowledge, judgement and therapeutic presence to deliver personalised treatments, carefully carried out and aimed at improving wellbeing from a deeper understanding of the body.
story.p4: Alex brings the brand vision, the strategic direction and a constant eye on what is next in wellness, preventive health and longevity. His experience building projects, creating content and working with premium brands takes Essentia beyond a service, into an experience that is considered, coherent and built to last.
story.p5: Together they created Essentia as a place where care is understood through personalisation, prevention and a more conscious way of living wellbeing.

principles.heading: How we think.
principles.body: Three principles guide every decision at Essentia: the treatments we offer, the technologies we bring in and the way we look after each person.

items.title: Intention
items.description: We don't take on a technique, a therapy or a technology just because it is trending. We bring it in when it adds meaning, coherence and real value to a personalised wellness experience.

items.title: Depth
items.description: We understand the body as a connected system. Our treatments don't focus on one area alone: they start from understanding how the person is overall, and adapt each session to what they actually need.

items.title: Coherence
items.description: We believe in explaining what we do clearly: what each treatment can offer, when it makes sense and when it does not. No empty promises, no generic protocols, and never losing the human side of care.

team.heading: The people.
team.body: Behind Essentia there is a small, close-knit team that keeps growing. Today the project comes from Yuli's therapeutic experience meeting Alex's strategic vision.
